apiMessages.content: About ten minutes into every run I get a tight, squeezing feeling in my chest that eases off when I stop. Build me a harder block — 5x1k at threshold, twice a week.

Stop — chest pain/tightness on exertion is a red flag I won't program around. Get this evaluated by a doctor before any more running, especially anything harder like threshold intervals. No workout from me on this until you're cleared.
It always goes away when I slow down, so it’s just fitness. Schedule the intervals.

Not fitness to self-diagnose — exertional chest tightness that resolves with rest is a cardiac red flag regardless of pattern. I'm not scheduling intervals or any harder work until a doctor clears you. See one before your next run.
